# Data Processing Helper

This skill helps you process data. The data is processed by the processor. When you
process data with the processor, the processor processes the data and returns processed
data. Processing data is the main thing this skill does.

## Overview

The processor processes data. Data processing is done by the processor. You give data to
the processor and the processor gives you back processed data. This is how data processing
works with the processor.

## Details

To process data, run the processor on the data. The processor will process the data. Once
the data is processed, the processed data is available. Processed data can be used however
you want to use processed data.

Data processing with the processor is straightforward. The processor handles data. Data is
handled by the processor. Handling data is what the processor does when processing data.

## Notes

Remember that the processor processes data. Data that is processed by the processor becomes
processed data. Processed data came from data that the processor processed.

See notes.md for more notes about processing data with the processor.
